mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which signals improving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines over the prior 3 months, or the rank correlation between UNRATE change and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an ultra-low interest rate environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the rank correlation between FEDFUNDS (below 0.5%) and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals a potential for central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 2.5%, or the rank correlation between the condition and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong housing market (HOUST > 900) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 6.0%), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to robust consumer spending and economic growth.
regime_hint: strong housing market and low unemployment
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 900 and UNRATE < 6.0%, or the rank correlation between the condition and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months signals a strengthening housing market, which indicates robust consumer demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises over the prior 3 months, or the rank correlation between HOUST change and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102.5, it signals strong economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 102.5, or the rank correlation between INDPRO (above 102.5) and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 138000 and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 950, it signals a robust economy with strong labor market and housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 138000 and HOUST > 950, or the rank correlation between the condition and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals a potential for central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 2.5%, or the rank correlation between CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 2.5% and SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
